name: Tequila Sunrise
description: Tequila and fresh orange juice layered with grenadine for a sunrise gradient, Mexico's most photogenic cocktail.
ingredients: a handful of fresh oregano, chopped
instructions: Combine the bolillo rolls and orange juice in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the dried oregano and lime wedges, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 0 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with salsa verde, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
tips: Serve in a chilled glass for the most refreshing result on a hot day.
If serving warm, gently reheat just before pouring rather than letting it come to a boil.
